title: DELA: Learning Controllable Edits for Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.32096v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) support bidirectional denoising and iterative refinement, but generation remains largely controlled by token-level masking schedules. This leaves draft-level refinement implicit and limits explicit control over when to insert missing content, delete redundant spans, revisit uncertain regions, or stop editing. We introduce Diffusion Editing Language Adapter (DELA), a plug-in framework that enables controllable draft refinement with a frozen DLM. DELA operates on clean, variable-length drafts using four explicit editing actions: Insert, Delete, Remask, and Stop. The controller determines when and where to edit the draft, while the frozen DLM fills masked regions through denoising, separating high-level edit control from token-level generation. A naive single-phase editor would be computationally expensive because arbitrary interior edits can disrupt prefix stability and limit reliable KV-cache reuse. To add

translated_title: DELA：为扩散语言模型学习可控编辑
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）支持双向去噪和迭代细化，但其生成过程在很大程度上仍由词元级的掩码调度所控制。这使得草稿级的细化过程是隐式的，限制了对何时插入缺失内容、删除冗余片段、重新审视不确定区域或停止编辑的显式控制能力。我们提出了扩散编辑语言适配器（Diffusion Editing Language Adapter，DELA），这是一个插件式框架，能够在冻结的 DLM 上实现可控的草稿细化。DELA 使用四种显式编辑操作——插入、删除、重新掩码和停止——对干净的可变长度草稿进行操作。控制器决定何时以及在哪里编辑草稿，而冻结的 DLM 通过去噪来填充被掩码的区域，从而将高层级的编辑控制与词元级的生成过程分离开来。一个朴素的单阶段编辑器在计算上会非常昂贵，因为任意的内部编辑会破坏前缀稳定性，并限制可靠的 KV 缓存重用。为了增加……
tldr: DELA 是一个插件式框架，通过插入、删除、重新掩码和停止四种显式编辑操作，在冻结的扩散语言模型上实现可控的草稿级细化，将高层编辑控制与词元级生成解耦。
en_tdlr: DELA is a plug-in framework that enables controllable draft refinement with a frozen diffusion language model via four explicit editing actions (Insert, Delete, Remask, Stop), decoupling high-level edit control from token-level generation.
